content.value_statement: Teams need repeatable guidance to build useful AI skills without adding unnecessary context. This skill provides a structured process for planning, writing, validating, and packaging skills.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use SKILL.md, references, scripts, and assets.
Provides a step-by-step process for planning, editing, packaging, and iterating skills.
Includes an initializer script that creates a template skill folder with example resources.
Includes a validator for frontmatter, naming rules, and description constraints.
Includes a packager that validates a skill and creates a distributable .skill archive.
Provides reference patterns for workflows and consistent output formats.
limitations: It does not create domain-specific logic for every new skill.
Generated templates require review and customization before publication.
Bundled scripts write local files and should run only in a trusted workspace.
The validator is basic and does not replace full marketplace review.

use_cases.title: Design a new team skill
use_cases.description: Plan triggers, structure, resources, and validation steps for a reusable internal AI skill.

use_cases.title: Convert process knowledge into a skill
use_cases.description: Turn workflow notes into concise skill instructions, references, and output patterns.

use_cases.title: Prepare a skill for distribution
use_cases.description: Validate frontmatter, test helper scripts, and package the skill into a distributable archive.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a basic skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new skill idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill-creation-guide to design a new skill for [task]. Ask for key examples first, then propose instructions, references, scripts, and assets.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an existing skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Refining a draft skill that already has content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my existing skill for [domain]. Identify what belongs in SKILL.md and what should move to references, scripts, or assets.

prompt_templates.title: Design workflow and output rules
prompt_templates.scenario: Creating a skill for complex or repeated work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a skill structure for [workflow] with clear triggering metadata, progressive disclosure, reusable resources, validation steps, and output quality rules.

prompt_templates.title: Audit packaging readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before distributing a skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this skill before packaging. Check frontmatter, directory structure, resource references, script needs, testing coverage, and packaging readiness.

output_examples.input: A team needs a skill for handling PDF editing requests.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a concise plan with trigger wording, required helper scripts, reference needs, testing steps, and packaging checks.

output_examples.input: A draft skill has a long SKILL.md with many examples.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests moving detailed examples into references while keeping only core workflow guidance in the main instructions.

output_examples.input: A maintainer wants to publish a community skill.
output_examples.output: The skill lists validation tasks, script testing expectations, resource cleanup steps, and package creation guidance.

best_practices: Start with concrete user examples before writing the skill structure.
Keep SKILL.md concise and move detailed material into referenced files.
Test helper scripts before packaging or sharing the skill.
anti_patterns: Adding broad background information that the agent already knows.
Putting every example and reference directly into SKILL.md.
Publishing generated templates without removing placeholders and unused resources.

faq.question: Does this skill create a complete skill automatically?
faq.answer: It provides an initializer and a structured process. You still need to customize content for the target domain.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it help package a skill?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance and a script that validates a skill before creating a .skill archive.

faq.question: Does it explain when to add scripts or assets?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes when scripts, references, and assets are useful for repeatable work.

faq.question: Is the included validation complete?
faq.answer: No. The validator checks basic structure and metadata. Marketplace security review is still required.

faq.question: Does the skill require network access?
faq.answer: No network use was found in the reviewed files. The bundled scripts operate on local skill files.
